title: Death of Caliph Harun al-Rashid
summary: The Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid died at Tus in Khurasan while on campaign against a rebellion. His empire was divided between his sons al-Amin and al-Ma'mun.
reason: He fell ill while marching east to put down a revolt in Khurasan.
significance: His reign was remembered as the height of Abbasid Baghdad, and the split between his sons led to civil war.
